description: Defines classes for ring buffer memory pools, including a simple ring buffer pool and a ticking ring buffer pool with overflow detection.

classes.name: ring_buffer_pool
classes.description: A memory pool that allocates byte spans using a ring memory allocator, assuming no overflows.

classes.name: ticking_ring_buffer_pool
classes.description: A ring buffer pool that tracks allocations over time, detects potential overflows, and deallocates old buffers based on ticks.

methods.name: allocate_buffer
methods.description: Allocates a span of bytes of specified size from the pool.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the memory pool.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Advances the internal tick counter and deallocates old buffers.
